svg.title: Luffing-jib tower crane — Turnkrani með lyftanlegri bómu
svg.desc: A tower crane raises a steep pivoting jib above a short counter-jib and a vertical hook line.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-luffing-jib-crane","label_en":"Luffing-jib tower crane","label_is":"Turnkrani með lyftanlegri bómu","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","crane"],"description":"A tower crane raises a steep pivoting jib above a short counter-jib and a vertical hook line.","design_note":"The upward luffing boom and support frame make its operating structure visibly different from a horizontal-jib crane.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
